configurePresets.name: windows-msvc
configurePresets.description: Native build on Windows. Untested in this repository; see README.

configurePresets.name: linux-gcc
configurePresets.description: Native build on Linux or WSL with the host GCC toolchain.

configurePresets.name: linux-arm64-cross
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile for aarch64 Linux. Needs the aarch64 GNU toolchain and host protoc/grpc_cpp_plugin on PATH.

configurePresets.name: linux-armv7-cross
configurePresets.description: Cross-compile for 32-bit ARMv7 hard-float Linux (Cortex-A7). Needs an arm-linux-gnueabihf toolchain and host protoc/grpc_cpp_plugin on PATH. Pass -DFLWR_ARMV7_SYSROOT=<target-rootfs> to link against target libraries.
